title: iRacing Pro Track Guide by Team Conti Sim Performance I NASCAR Xfinity at Chicagoland Speedway

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Turn in early and use the apron to set up for the banking.
corners.mistakes: Avoid using the grass as it adds stress to the right front tire.

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Look where stands end, brake before, close to wall
corners.line: Parallel to wall, turn-in just before stands end

corners.braking: Brake before the seam patch, lift before crossing it.
corners.line: Turn-in before the seam patch, apex around the white line.
corners.exit: Maintain partial throttle into the banking, watch for bumps.
corners.mistakes: Avoid lifting too early and using too much wheel input.

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Hold partial throttle through the banking transition and maintain it until apex.
corners.mistakes: Adding too much wheel input to break the car free.

corners.label: T2
corners.exit: Maintain full throttle after iRacing logo and billboard on right.
corners.mistakes: Opening the wheel up too early to the light.

corners.label: T2
corners.exit: Maintain line to safer barrier, peak exit near concrete wall.

corners.label: T3
corners.line: Curve back to follow radius, lift off throttle, maintain partial throttle
corners.exit: Feel same quality centered exit as turn two
corners.mistakes: Watch for bumps, avoid hitting splitter

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: shallow entry up just a hair at the initial turn away from the wall
corners.line: pointed all the way down to this white line
corners.exit: keep the front and rear working together to hold your apex line
corners.mistakes: turn in too late and have to dump too much throttle out to get the front to turn

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Before crossing the middle seam, start lifting phase
corners.line: Clip the white line where the billboards end, apex on the white line
corners.exit: Maintain momentum on exit, partial throttle
corners.mistakes: Too much throttle through bumps, throwing the car left or right

corners.label: T3
corners.exit: wrap the bottom a little bit longer

corners.label: T3
corners.mistakes: don't go to the wall through the bumps

corners.label: T4
corners.mistakes: don't go to the wall through the bumps

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Utilize banking as long as possible, then brake to downshift to third and second.
corners.line: Partial throttle at center, manage balance.
corners.mistakes: Maximize entry down crossing banking to apron.

corners.braking: cross this, get the front slowed down enough to turn
corners.line: on the racing line, cross the bank and down on the apron
corners.exit: straight line entry, no brake, below the cone
corners.mistakes: slide the front, get a penalty

corners.line: attack the middle of the track
corners.mistakes: speed loss out of the center, not gaining lap time

corners.line: skeptical of running the second lane due to bumps
corners.mistakes: waiting on the front to settle, too aggressive for the car to turn

general_tips: Utilize throttle effectively to minimize speed loss
Second or third lap is usually optimal time
Utilize apron and grass at start finish line
Maintain the banking and avoid the apron for tire longevity.
Manage the balance of the car to keep the front and rear turning without excessive wheel input.
Maintain partial throttle until you can maintain balance and grip.
The back straight is actually a back stretch with a curve.
Look for same balance and readability of the front as in previous turns
Maintain partial throttle longer into the lap.
Minimize throttle on entry to keep car balanced.
Find minimal speed in the corner to maintain balance.
Maintain balance of the car neutral and capable through the center of the corner.
Find minimal speed just before starting to work back to linear.
Hold throttle all the way to keep apex.
Minimal speed is before 100% throttle moment.
Regain momentum after 100% throttle moment.
